Shell.tagline: A free, open, AI-connected personal operating system

About.title: About
About.intro: A personal operating system: boards, career, habits and money, in a keyboard-first, terminal-styled web app.

features.boards: Boards: kanban and table views, calendar, trash and offline capture.
features.career: Career: a job pipeline, CV, interview prep and growth surfaces.
features.life: Life: habits, goals, notes, focus, finance, health and learning.
features.global: Global: notifications, tags, search and a command palette.

About.languageHint: This page is translated. The rest of the app is English while the locales are filled in.
